name: omnilab/gbif
description: Omnilab GBIF: a taxon of GBIF's taxonomy (the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release since June 2026) by its key, its legacy GBIF Backbone number, its NCBI Taxonomy id or a scientific name GBIF matches - its name, authority, rank, status, IUCN Red List category, common name, publication and classification, its legacy number and NCBI id as cross-references, its parent as a related thing - a search, and the occurrences of a place and a period (by taxon, country, basis of record), each with its time and place and its taxon related, through the GBIF API, no key needed.
